column1: # Requirements proven by review, not by a test: the requirement, a tab, how it is verified.

column2: Paths are built with path.join; the only process the code starts is git (spec 073's history reader, with a time limit of 60 s on its own calls) and every network call is spec 109's (GET, a time limit each). CI runs the suite on both boot-machine platforms and as a user who is not root: .github/workflows/ci.yml job "check" (Bun and Node) and job "suite" (matrix windows-latest, macos-latest); the tests that sign commits or take about 20 s carry { timeout: 180_000 }, and the tests use the sandbox's own git identity file.
